prompt.zh-CN: 传统情景喜剧里常见的“罐头笑声”主要有什么作用？
prompt.en-US: What is the main purpose of canned laughter in traditional sitcoms?

text.zh-CN: 提示喜剧节奏和观众反应
text.en-US: To signal comic timing and audience reaction
To prove the characters are underwater

reveal.zh-CN: 罐头笑声会影响观众对笑点节奏的感知，也是一种传统电视制作习惯。
reveal.en-US: Canned laughter shapes how viewers perceive joke timing and is a traditional TV production device.

prompt.zh-CN: 真人秀里“剪辑叙事”最能影响什么？
prompt.en-US: In reality TV, editing most strongly affects what?

text.zh-CN: 观众对人物和冲突的理解
text.en-US: How viewers understand characters and conflicts

reveal.zh-CN: 剪辑会选择顺序、反应和上下文，能显著改变观众的叙事感受。
reveal.en-US: Editing selects order, reactions, and context, greatly changing how viewers experience the story.

title.en-US: Must a season equal a year?

prompt.zh-CN: 判断：电视剧的一季必然对应现实中的一年。
prompt.en-US: True or false: one TV season must correspond to one real-world year.

reveal.zh-CN: “一季”是播出和制作单位，不一定等于剧中时间或现实一年。
reveal.en-US: A season is a release and production unit; it does not have to equal story time or one real-world year.

title.en-US: Why soap operas are called soap operas

prompt.zh-CN: 英语里的 soap opera 名称与早期哪类赞助商关系密切？
prompt.en-US: The term soap opera is closely linked to which early sponsors?

reveal.zh-CN: 早期日间连续剧常由清洁用品品牌赞助，因此得名 soap opera。
reveal.en-US: Early daytime serial dramas were often sponsored by cleaning product brands, giving rise to the term soap opera.

prompt.zh-CN: 迷你剧 miniseries 通常有什么特点？

text.zh-CN: 集数较少，有相对完整的有限故事
text.en-US: Few episodes with a relatively complete limited story
Each episode must last exactly one minute
It can only be played inside a microwave

reveal.zh-CN: 迷你剧一般不是无限延展的长篇连续剧，而是有限篇幅的完整叙事。
reveal.en-US: A miniseries is usually a limited narrative rather than an indefinitely extended long-running series.
